name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog:
* Locking a website is now a real lock: while a teammate has it locked, the website refuses pushes and undos from anyone else, and says who has it and since when. Downloading is never blocked.
* Every lock, unlock, take over and refused push is noted, and shown on the WebsitePusher page.
